runlog.text: Released the PipeMend benchmark with a Zenodo DOI
Published the first newsletter issue, on why data quality checks approve wrong AI fixes
Released the LEGATO preprint and the ETL-TransBench benchmark
Joined Salesforce as Lead Member of Technical Staff

research.title: Domain-Driven Data and AI Platforms: Governing Analytics and Machine Learning Pipelines at Scale
research.summary: A domain-driven reference architecture for governing analytics and ML pipelines in large enterprises.

research.title: LEGATO: Agentic LLM Translation of Legacy ETL Workflows to Modern Dataflow Code with Test-Based Semantic Verification
research.summary: An agent that translates legacy ETL into Spark and checks every translation against executable data tests.

research.title: Fix or Page? Silent Harm and Safe Escalation When LLM Agents Remediate Data Pipeline Incidents
research.summary: 64 pipeline incidents, three model sizes: data quality checks approved every harmful fix; the agents' own confidence caught most of them.

research.title: Event-driven medallion architecture for credit risk feature engineering
research.summary: Event-driven medallion pipelines for credit risk feature engineering, with open-source code.

research.title: A domain-driven architecture for scalable and regulated lakehouse systems on Snowflake
research.summary: Governance that propagates across domains, measured with a reproducible Snowflake benchmark.
